message.content: {"scores":{"c1":10,"c2":10,"c3":7},"evidence":"c1: The isinstance check returns False for floats. All four docstring examples come out right: 5,2,7 gives True (7=5+2); 3,2,2 gives False; 3,-2,1 gives True (3=-2+1... wait, actually 1=3+(-2), which is the z==x+y case); 3.6,-2.2,2 gives False. Excluding bools is a defensible extra and is not part of the docstring examples. c2: The sum logic covers all three cases. 0,0,0 gives True and 0,1,1 gives True (1=0+1). Large ints work with no overflow. c3: The logic is valid and every path returns a bool. However, the first line 'if not all(...)' has no leading indentation, so it does not fit the function body as required. Pasting it under the def as-is would raise an IndentationError. This counts as a minor-to-moderate formatting defect."}
